scope.disposition: Two independently accepted scoped original-domain exclusion theorems

four_phase.distribution: 3+1, one moving edge per active branch

five_phase.distribution: 3+2, one moving edge per active branch
five_phase.reference_weights: Frozen rho reference weights are multiplied, never inverted; no new variable guard.

scope.theorem: No legal point in either stated family is externally invertible-complex row/column monomial-equivalent to F8. All six original inverse guards and arbitrary complex unit phases are retained.
scope.original_model: Pinned N=8 chart, six ordered cycles, seeds 42420/42520, all original Gaussian gains and fourteen fixed tree edges, unweighted three-Green sums and M=S1*S0.
scope.count_boundary: Separate coordinate-label counts, never added as disjoint coverage, matrix images, symmetry classes or discoveries. Four-phase families can occur inside five-phase families by fixing an extra multiplier to one. Other lower-dimensional intersections with earlier accepted families remain possible.
scope.ideal_boundary: These certificates lie in the original 784 H-minor ideal. Neither asserts the unit ideal, removes pole/zero-coordinate components, or embeds Q(i) into a finite field.
open: Distribution 3+3 and other unsupported coordinate families
not_claimed: Surviving legal witness from inconclusive ranks
scope.execution_boundary: Package verification runs no research code. Original author and independent reviewer runs retain their own attribution.
